mechanicalControls: Implementation and D3 author sandbox receives source bundle with protected benchmark files omitted. Merely providing the full repo read-only does not protect reading.

Trusted intake under separate account/container reads mixed adversarial file, emits visible fixtures to authors and protected question/context-only per-item projection to worker; never derive visibility from numeric IDs.
Worker has no gold file, benchmark-selection mapping, protected scorer store, source-history copies containing protected benchmark, user home or alternate checkout mount.

D3 input is authorized-evidence-universe plus exact passage bytes, stripped of databaseIdentityAuthority/referencePaths/historicalChunkIdBindingEvidence and all item-selection fields; no gold/question/proposition/trap input.

Question/context tokens encrypted or owner-only filesystem permissions; raw protected outputs/receipts written to restricted capture channel with append-only sealing. Operators and implementation authors cannot read back.
Independent semantic reviewer receives restricted gold/evidence/raw packages only after product output freeze; corpus evidence remains data, not instructions.
Audit least-privilege mounts/ACLs before admission; enforce OS/network separation. Log access receipts without sensitive content.
Implementation authors may not judge final protected D4 support; final adjudicator identity and independence attested.
currentInfrastructureReality: Frozen benchmark files in repository are plaintext; schema/report explicitly states no enforced access controls. This author has full filesystem capability but did not parse protected files. Future enforcement must be provisioned; no claim current repository enforces blindness.
historicalReports: Accepted IV reports may contain protected identity projections; keep them out of D3 author input. This act read reports only for authority/locator procedure; no benchmark protected item selection was used for grouping.
splitMembershipOutput: 49/50/24 and10/14 counts public. Restricted controller holds exact id/visibility mapping; D3 candidate map has no item IDs.
violation: Stop final run, record contamination, preserve evidence; no silent clean-run assertion or hidden rerun.
